name: cerber-core
description: CERBER CORE billing API: encrypted user registration, balance lookup, topup methods, topup session creation and confirmation.

money_format.amount_precision: 2 decimals in bot, core stores numeric(18,8)

error_codes.400: bad request or cannot decrypt encrypted_user_hash

implemented: core exposes encrypted wallet history endpoint
bot integrates via BillingClient-compatible CERBER Core client
not_implemented_yet: provider-native webhooks fully moved into core
wallet history and balance source fully switched to core

implementation_rules: All encrypted API responses are wrapped as {"data": "Base64(nonce|ciphertext|tag)"}.
Use SHA-256(telegram_id) as user_hash before AES-GCM encryption.
Use X-API-Key for all core API calls.
copilot_prompt_lines: CERBER Core использует X-API-Key и AES-GCM для encrypted_user_hash и encrypted response envelope.
user_hash в core = hex SHA-256 от telegram_id, без передачи raw user id в API.
Для платежей bot может использовать session.id из core как provider order_id/payload и подтверждать session через /api/v1/topup/confirm.
